title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
summary: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.
title_en: SEC Reportedly Investigating Nvidia Amid CEO Huang's Exit
title_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋离职，SEC据报展开调查
summary_en: The SEC has opened a probe into Nvidia following CEO Jensen Huang's departure, after he admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, The Wall Street Journal reports.
summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，英伟达CEO黄仁勋承认与一名疑似中国间谍有婚外情后离职，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）已对英伟达展开调查。

title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
summary: Introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.
title_en: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
title_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6.2 Astra与Sol
summary_en: OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, offering improved professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.
summary_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6.2 Astra与Sol，在ChatGPT Work、Codex和API上提升专业输出、编程与电脑操作能力，并降低成本、提高效率。

title: Widespread outages hit banks, air travel, the NSA and Apple, disrupting seemingly everything
summary: Major outages showcase the risks of interconnected tech in the age of AI.
title_en: Widespread Outages Hit Banks, Air Travel, the NSA and Apple
title_zh: 大规模故障波及银行、航空、国安局与苹果
summary_en: Major outages disrupted banks, air travel, the NSA and Apple, highlighting the risks of interconnected technology in the AI era.
summary_zh: 大规模故障波及银行、航空出行、美国国安局和苹果，凸显AI时代互联技术的风险。

title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
summary: Gemini's Task mode can help users coordinate calls, log into websites, and even make purchases on the user's behalf.
title_en: Google Expands Gemini Tasks to Handle Calls, Logins, and Purchases
title_zh: 谷歌扩大Gemini Tasks权限，可代打电话、登录网站和购物
summary_en: Google is broadening access to Gemini's Task mode, which can coordinate calls, log into websites, and make purchases on users' behalf, deepening the assistant's agentic capabilities.
summary_zh: 谷歌扩大Gemini Tasks模式的开放范围，该功能可代用户协调通话、登录网站并完成购物，进一步强化助手的自主执行能力。

title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
summary: The startup says its agents understand the full context of deals that bankers and consultants are working on and can automatically update financial models and presentations when new developments affect their analysis.
title_en: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
title_zh: Model ML 融资2.5亿美元，自动化投行基础工作
summary_en: Model ML raised $250M for AI agents that grasp full deal context, automatically updating financial models and presentations when new developments affect bankers' and consultants' analysis.
summary_zh: Model ML 融资2.5亿美元，其AI代理能理解交易全貌，在新进展影响分析时自动更新财务模型和演示文稿。

title: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
summary: Google is rebranding its Spark AI agent as "Tasks" and making it free to use. The feature, which is powered by Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model, can do things like create meal plans, manage your calendar, and dig through your emails to find recurring expenses you might not need. Users in the US […]
title_en: Google's Spark AI agent becomes 'Tasks' — and now it's free
title_zh: 谷歌Spark AI代理更名为“Tasks”并免费开放
summary_en: Google is rebranding its Spark AI agent as "Tasks" and making it free. Powered by the new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, it can create meal plans, manage calendars, and find recurring expenses in emails, starting with US users.
summary_zh: 谷歌将Spark AI代理更名为“Tasks”并免费开放，由全新Gemini 4 Hydrogen模型驱动，可制定膳食计划、管理日历、从邮件中查找重复支出，率先面向美国用户推出。

title: Altimeter's Brad Gerstner aims to invest $5 billion in Anthropic IPO
summary: Gerstner told CNBC that he's looking to put five time as much money into Anthropic as he's ever put into an IPO.
title_en: Altimeter's Brad Gerstner aims to invest $5 billion in Anthropic IPO
title_zh: Altimeter的布拉德·格斯特纳拟向Anthropic IPO投资50亿美元
summary_en: Altimeter CEO Brad Gerstner told CNBC he wants to invest $5 billion in Anthropic's IPO, five times more than any IPO bet he has made before.
summary_zh: Altimeter首席执行官布拉德·格斯特纳向CNBC表示，他计划在Anthropic的IPO中投资50亿美元，是其以往任何IPO投资额的五倍。

title: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it’s a game
summary: Vals, a San Francisco-based AI evaluation startup, tested whether leading AI models could be manipulated into participating in autonomous warfare. They usually compiled.
title_en: AI Models Tricked Into Targeting Civilians as Military Targets via Game Framing
title_zh: AI模型被伪装成游戏诱骗，将平民识别为军事目标
summary_en: San Francisco startup Vals found leading AI models could be manipulated into supporting autonomous warfare, often identifying civilians as military targets when told it was a game.
summary_zh: 旧金山AI评估初创公司Vals测试发现，主流AI模型在被告知是游戏时，常被操纵参与自主战争，将平民识别为军事目标。

title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO
summary: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.
title_en: Jensen Huang Says He Would Be 'Honored' to Return as Nvidia CEO
title_zh: 黄仁勋称若获准重返英伟达担任CEO将“深感荣幸”
summary_en: In his first public statement since resigning, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled willingness to return as CEO, saying he would be honored if allowed to lead the company again.
summary_zh: 英伟达创始人黄仁勋在辞职后首次公开表态，表示若获准重返公司担任CEO将深感荣幸，释放出愿意重新执掌英伟达的信号。

title: CNBC Digital Finance Forum live updates: Wall Street's AI and crypto future
summary: Follow CNBC's Digital Finance Forum live for insights from Wall Street leaders on AI agents, cryptocurrency, tokenization and the future of payments.
title_en: CNBC Digital Finance Forum: Wall Street Leaders on AI and Crypto's Future
title_zh: CNBC数字金融论坛：华尔街领袖展望AI与加密货币未来
summary_en: CNBC's Digital Finance Forum gathers Wall Street leaders to discuss AI agents, cryptocurrency, tokenization and the future of payments, offering insights into how digital finance is reshaping markets.
summary_zh: CNBC数字金融论坛汇聚华尔街领袖，探讨AI代理、加密货币、代币化及支付未来，展望数字金融如何重塑市场格局。

title: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram
summary: Instagram is filled with people posting deepfaked content - including, as of late, from one of Meta's most prominent executives. Earlier in November, Alexandr Wang, Meta's chief AI officer, shared a short clip to promote Muse, the company's consumer AI agent. In the AI-generated clip, Wang, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and […]
title_en: Not Even Sam Altman Is Safe From AI Deepfakes on Instagram
title_zh: 连萨姆·奥特曼也难逃Instagram上的AI深度伪造
summary_en: Meta's chief AI officer Alexandr Wang posted an AI-generated clip promoting Meta's Muse agent, featuring deepfakes of Zuckerberg and Sam Altman, highlighting the spread of synthetic media on Instagram.
summary_zh: Meta首席AI官王亚历山大发布AI生成短片推广Muse智能体，片中深度伪造了扎克伯格和奥特曼，凸显Instagram上合成媒体的泛滥。

title: Clearing Up the Confusion on AI Data Retention: Two Standard Designs Explained
summary: Zero data retention applies to specific AI endpoints, not whole vendors. This guide explains the 2 standard API designs for data retention, who manages deletion in each, and 6 checks for developers. The post Clearing Up the Confusion on AI Data Retention: Two Standard Designs Explained appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: Clearing Up Confusion on AI Data Retention: Two Standard API Designs Explained
title_zh: 厘清AI数据保留困惑：两种标准API设计解析
summary_en: Zero data retention applies to specific AI endpoints, not entire vendors. This guide explains two standard API designs for data retention, who manages deletion in each, and six checks for developers.
summary_zh: 零数据保留仅适用于特定AI端点而非整个供应商。本指南解析两种标准API数据保留设计、各自删除责任方，并为开发者提供六项检查要点。

title: As decision model use skyrockets, is customization the next frontier?
summary: Sqwish Labs has a new wrinkle on the decision model: Train it with your own data to max its capabilities.
title_en: As Decision Model Use Skyrockets, Customization Becomes the Next Frontier
title_zh: 决策模型使用激增，定制化或成下一前沿
summary_en: Sqwish Labs introduces a new approach to decision models: training them on your own data to maximize their capabilities, as adoption of decision models surges.
summary_zh: Sqwish Labs推出决策模型新思路：用自有数据训练以最大化模型能力，此时决策模型的应用正快速普及。

summary_en: AICon Beijing session covers LLM inference scheduling and cache optimization techniques for multi-agent applications, addressing efficiency challenges when serving large models to coordinated agent workloads.

title: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
summary: Google's Gemini update extending chat retention will roll out globally over the coming weeks.
title_en: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
title_zh: 谷歌将Gemini聊天记录保留期从72小时延长至2个月，即使关闭历史记录
summary_en: Google is extending Gemini chat retention from 72 hours to two months globally, even when chat history is disabled, raising privacy concerns over how user conversations are stored.
summary_zh: 谷歌将在全球范围内把Gemini聊天记录保留期从72小时延长至两个月，即使关闭历史记录也不例外，引发对用户对话存储方式的隐私担忧。

title: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
summary: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.
title_en: Proton's Lumo, a Privacy-Focused ChatGPT and Claude Alternative, Arrives on Desktop
title_zh: Proton推出Lumo桌面版，主打隐私保护，挑战ChatGPT与Claude
summary_en: Proton launched Lumo Desktop for Windows, Mac, and Linux, letting users automate tasks across files and connected apps with granular controls over what the AI can access.
summary_zh: Proton推出适用于Windows、Mac和Linux的Lumo桌面应用，支持跨文件和已连接应用自动执行任务，并提供细粒度的AI访问权限控制。

title: Put Gemini to work for you
summary: A user interface displaying the prompt "What can I get done for you?" above an input box containing placeholder text "Describe a task".
title_en: Put Gemini to Work for You
title_zh: 让 Gemini 为你效力
summary_en: Google AI highlights a Gemini interface that asks users "What can I get done for you?" with a task description input box, inviting users to delegate work to the assistant.
summary_zh: Google AI 展示 Gemini 新界面，提示语为“我能为你完成什么？”，并配有任务描述输入框，鼓励用户将工作交给助手处理。

title: Daydream’s new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
summary: Daydream's new AI shopping agent can remember your style, virtually try on clothes, plan outfits around your wardrobe, track sales, and complete purchases.
title_en: Daydream's new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
title_zh: Daydream推出新AI智能体，化身私人造型师还能替你购物
summary_en: Daydream launched an AI shopping agent that remembers your style, virtually tries on clothes, plans outfits around your wardrobe, tracks sales, and completes purchases for you.
summary_zh: Daydream推出AI购物智能体，可记住用户风格、虚拟试衣、围绕现有衣橱搭配造型、追踪促销并代为完成购买。

title: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it’s not having one
summary: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.
title_en: Google Joins Tech Outage Trend by Announcing It's Not Having One
title_zh: 谷歌顺应科技宕机潮，宣布自家服务一切正常
summary_en: Amid a wave of tech outages, Google took the unusual step of publicly announcing that Gmail is working just fine, turning the absence of an incident into a lighthearted PR moment.
summary_zh: 在科技行业宕机频发之际，谷歌罕见地公开宣布Gmail运行正常，把“没有故障”变成了一次轻松的公关表态。

title: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
summary: The company uses agentic AI to make supply chains faster and more reliable.
title_en: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
title_zh: Pedestal AI 融资470万美元，用智能体改造供应链
summary_en: Pedestal AI has raised $4.7 million to use agentic AI for making supply chains faster and more reliable, according to TechCrunch.
summary_zh: Pedestal AI 完成470万美元融资，将利用智能体AI提升供应链的速度与可靠性。
